hook: *225* graduate at NIPER Hyderabad's convocation tomorrow
hook_b: *225* graduate at NIPER Hyderabad's convocation tomorrow
tldr: The pharma institute's 14th convocation is on Friday, Nov 27, at its Balanagar campus.

beats.what: 210 Master's students of the 2024-26 batch and 15 Ph.D. scholars graduate.
beats.why: NIPER Hyderabad trains researchers for India's pharma sector, a big Hyderabad industry.
beats.care: Expect convocation crowds around the Balanagar campus on Friday.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Department of Pharmaceuticals senior economic advisor Awadhesh Kumar Choudhary and Dhanush Group MD DSN Murthy will attend; Director Shailendra Saraf presents the institute report.

cards.q: Pharma grads: where should they work?

qs: How many of these graduates will stay with Hyderabad's pharma industry?

facts.t: *12* meritorious students will receive gold medals.

viz.verdict: Most graduates are Master's students of the 2024-26 batch.

learn.t: NIPER = National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research

watch: The institute report on research and placements at Friday's ceremony.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: 225 students to graduate at NIPER Hyderabad's 14th convocation on Friday

fact: NIPER Hyderabad confers degrees on *225* students at Balanagar on Friday
twist: *12* students get gold medals; only *15* of the 225 are Ph.D. scholars.
